Key design decisions recorded (against the design doc, disclosed):

- **`v_claim_sightings` is the edge-list view, not the aggregate.**
  The ticket wants an explicit-column `sig_export`-only view (J3 T-2);
  K5 §3.1's SQL is the aggregate. The view exposes the join's columns
  (claim/subject/object_entity/predicate/tier/sys_period/rights +
  artifact/source/capture/binding/run/timestamp); the
  `EXPORT_QUERIES` key runs K5's GROUP BY over the view, re-joining
  `claim`/`evidence_artifact`/`claim_evidence` for the shared gate
  fragments' fixed aliases and `claim_source`/`rights_record` for the
  effective-rights gate (the publishable-claim semantics every
  sibling read applies — `rr.redistributable = 'yes'`).
- **Contribution attribution is by the claim's source of record**
  (`claim_source.source_id`), while first/last-seen timing comes from
  the bound captures. K5 §3.1's literal `ea.source_id` grouping would
  attribute a shared-establishment claim to the *establishing* source
  and leave the asserting source's page claiming zero claims beside
  its emitted records — the `published_claims`/`contributions`
  numbers would fork from J3's source rows. `claim_source` is the
  spine's own "who asserted this" record; the capture columns then
  honestly report *when SIG's evidence saw it*, under whichever run
  captured it.
- **Dossier key set = declared buckets ∪ placement-chain jkeys.** The
  dossier set today is `dataset.jurisdictions` (declared buckets +
  `unresolved`); K5's ancestor roll-up adds every chain jkey
  (country/admin-1/county/place ancestors) so the artifact set is
  ready for the at-every-level dossiers P35.45 emits. Membership is
  the union — declared bucket (the dossier page's own record set) OR
  placement-chain membership — and the `declared_here_located_elsewhere`
  / `located_here_declared_elsewhere` splits disclose the R4
  disagreements. `unresolved` carries emitted subjects with no placed
  chain plus the unresolved-declared bucket.
- **`completed run` = `completion_status = 'ok'`** for both the
  run_level_only precondition and the latest-complete-run rule — one
  vocabulary (the four-state `ok|partial|quota_reached|failed`
  closure), never a second definition.
- **`freshness_state` + `known_issues` are read back from the emitted
  transparency artifacts** (`transparency/freshness.jsonl` /
  `transparency/issues.jsonl` bytes), so the dossier artifact can
  never drift from the J3 streams — one computation.
- **`downloads`/`cross_source.colocated_pairs`** emit the recorded
  honest absences (`[]` / `{"not_evaluable": …}`) pending DSRC-03 /
  DSRC-04 — the slots exist, the gates are named.
- **Slug paths are flat** (`jurisdiction_slug(jkey)` →
  `iso3166-2-us-ca`), matching the `/dossier/<slug>/` route scheme
  (K5's `usa/ca` example predates JUR-02a's flat slugs).

## Phase 3 — self-review

Mechanical: `git diff --check` clean; `ruff check`/`format` green;
`mypy -p exports -p policy` clean. Read-through of the landed diff:

- **Aggregate join cardinality verified 1:1** — `claim_evidence` PK is
  `(claim_id, capture_id, role)`; `claim_source` and `latest_decision`
  are `DISTINCT ON` CTEs; `evidence_artifact`/`rights_record` join on
  PKs. `count(*)` (`sighting_links`) cannot inflate.
- **Gate fragments resolve against the substituted aliases** —
  `{PUB_CLAIM_GATE}`→`c` (the view carries
  `subject_id`/`object_entity`/`sys_period` for exactly this),
  `{PUB_ARTIFACT_GATE}`→`ea.artifact_id`,
  `{CAPTURE_SEAL_GATE}`→`ce.capture_id`,
  `{SIGHTING_BOUND}`→`bound_at <= occ_bound`, and
  `upper_inf(c.sys_period)`→ the belief filter — same substitution as
  sibling reads (the T1/T2 closure tests pin the tokens).
- **Roll-up:** `jurisdiction_chain` is root-first and includes the
  leaf jkey, so `{declared, *chain}` covers leaf + ancestors +
  declared bucket; `ancestor_chain` excludes self for the emitted
  `chain` field (K5 example `["iso3166-1:US"]`).
- **`run_level_only`** fires on `max(sighting_links) ≤ 1` over the
  source's whole sighting set AND >1 `ok` runs — per-source, one
  `completion_status` vocabulary.
- **Manifest/registration:** `.runs.jsonl.gz` → `application/gzip`,
  `dossier_source_runs` resource + `RUNS_ROW_SCHEMA` +
  `(row_count, distinct sources)` counts; the `.json` document is a
  column-exempt document like its `web/*` siblings.
- **One computation, really:** `contributions_by_source` is built
  from the same `_DossierAcc` maps the dossier docs render, and the
  dossier source rows read the emitted `transparency/*` bytes back —
  no second derivation exists to drift.
- **Digest files:** the operator's untracked
  `docs/build/reports/digests/2026-10-20/21.md` stay untracked (P35.43
  convention — verified locally by moving aside, never committed).
